exact_observations: GroebnerBasis.__new__ calls parallel_poly_from_expr then PolyRing then ring.from_dict then _groebner with opt.method.
groebnertools.groebner maps explicit buchberger to _buchberger; _buchberger reduces via rem, monic and spoly.
rings._term_div uses domain.quo when domain.is_Field; Field.quo is a/b; ModularInteger.__truediv__ directly multiplies by inversion, bypassing __mul__.
rings.rem subtracts c*cg from accumulated coefficient; monic calls quo_ground, which skips x==one otherwise calls domain.quo per term.
spoly mul_monom shifts exponents only then subtracts polynomials; no coefficient multiplication required for that shift.
rings.square uses v**2 for diagonal terms and multiplies cross terms, doubles via imul_num. __pow__ may select multinomial/generic routines.
external.gmpy reads SYMPY_GROUND_TYPES before import, only enters flint or gmpy detection for their enumerated values or auto. Proposed python selection needs future actual assertion.
Certificate row modulus is ell=subgroup order and every named point satisfies ell*P=O; this is distinct from coefficient p.
Certificate canonicalization uses JCS and decimal strings for integers; schedules have unique64hex attemptseeds, roots and predeclared retries only, exactreceiptbijection, fullresourceownership.
